text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: One day, while out and about with<n>Taiki Shuttle...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Take a gander at that machine! It's<n>chock-full of
Umamusume toys!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
She points toward a claw machine<n>filled with
Umamusume plushies.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
It says they're called "Cuties"! I'll be<n>darned if
they don't live up to their<n>name, hehe!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Betcha my little sisters would<n>appreciate one of
these. I should<n>send 'em some!
choice_data_list: All right, I'll win some for you!
All right, I'll win some for you!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Ya will?! Thanks so much! Now, go<n>on—show me
what ya got!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: There's no way I can fail now!
